headline: Ashjar Cafe  / Studio Ahmed Aldossary
context: As Saudi Arabia's coffee culture continues to grow, cafés have become an important third place for many Saudis. Ashjar, meaning "trees" in Arabic, was conceived as a small urban escape within Riyadh , shaped by gardens, water, and shade.
